title: American-Style Chicken Fried Rice
description: A classic Chinese-American dish, this recipe combines cooked rice, chicken, and vegetables in a savory sauce.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the diced chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the skillet.
Add the chopped scallions and cook until they start to soften, about 1 minute.
Push the scallions to one side of the skillet.
Add a little more oil if necessary, then add the diced egg and scramble it until cooked through.
Mix the egg with the scallions.
Add the cooked chicken back into the skillet and stir to combine with the egg and scallions.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet, breaking up any clumps with a spatula.
Stir-fry the rice with the chicken and egg mixture for about 2-3 minutes, until everything is well combined.
Add the soy sauce and oyster sauce to the skillet, and stir-fry for another minute.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the chicken fried rice to a serving platter and serve hot.
